group.passage: Taiwan's high-speed rail began carrying passengers in January 2007. Its trains run along the west coast between Taipei in the north and Kaohsiung in the south, a distance of about 345 kilometers. Before the line opened, this trip took about five hours by regular train or by bus. In 2007, the fastest high-speed trains needed only about 90 minutes, and between stations they reached almost 300 kilometers per hour. The chart below shows how many passengers the high-speed rail carried in each year from 2007 to 2025. In its first year, the high-speed rail carried 15.6 million passengers. The company kept adding trains to its daily schedule during that year, and in 2008 the total almost doubled. The fast new trains also pulled many travelers away from planes. Within a year, some flights between cities in Taiwan lost more than half of their passengers, and airlines canceled dozens of flights. After that, the number of riders kept climbing every year. In 2015, some trains began stopping at three new stations in Miaoli, Changhua, and Yunlin, and by 2019 the yearly total had reached 67.4 million. Then the COVID-19 pandemic arrived. In 2020, fewer people traveled, so the company ran fewer trains for a while. Things got even worse in May 2021, when Taiwan raised its COVID-19 alert to level 3 and the number of riders fell sharply. The total for 2021 was only 43.5 million, the lowest since 2011. The drop did not last long, however. Ridership bounced back after pandemic rules were relaxed: people returned to the trains, and in 2023 the high-speed rail set a new record of 73.1 million passengers. The total rose again in 2024, and in 2025 the trains carried 82.1 million people, more than five times as many as in the first year. These numbers show how quickly the high-speed rail has become a part of daily life for many people in Taiwan.

translation_zh.text:
台灣高鐵在 2007 年 1 月開始載客。列車沿著西海岸行駛，往來北部的台北和南部的高雄之間，距離約 345 公里。在高鐵通車以前，這趟路搭一般火車或客運大約要五個小時。2007 年時，最快的高鐵列車只需要大約 90 分鐘，在兩站之間時速接近 300 公里。下面的圖表顯示高鐵從 2007 年到 2025 年每年載運的旅客人數。
通車第一年，高鐵載運了 1,560 萬人次。那一年公司不斷增加每天的班次，到了 2008 年，總人數幾乎翻倍。快速的新列車也把許多旅客從飛機那裡吸引過來。不到一年，台灣有些城市之間的航班就少了一半以上的乘客，航空公司也取消了數十個航班。在那之後，搭乘人數每年持續攀升。2015 年，部分列車開始停靠苗栗、彰化和雲林三個新車站；到了 2019 年，全年總人數已經達到 6,740 萬人次。
接著新冠肺炎疫情來襲。2020 年出門旅行的人變少，公司因此有一段時間減少班次。2021 年 5 月情況更糟，台灣把疫情警戒提升到第三級，搭乘人數大幅下跌。2021 年全年只有 4,350 萬人次，是 2011 年以來最低。
不過，這次下跌並沒有持續很久。防疫規定放寬後，搭乘人數回升了：人們回到列車上，2023 年高鐵以 7,310 萬人次創下新紀錄。2024 年總人數再度增加，2025 年列車載運了 8,210 萬人次，是第一年的五倍以上。這些數字顯示，高鐵很快就成為台灣許多人日常生活的一部分。

The total rose again in 2024, and in 2025 the trains carried 82.1 million people, more than five times as many as in the first year.（f13、d1：2024＝78.250483、2025＝82.070618，82.07 ÷ 15.56 ≈ 5.3）
